args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks in production after the v2.3.1 deploy, with an elevated error rate of 18% across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Action taken: rolled back the service in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: the initial rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error) and was retried to complete us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback, all regions are on v2.3.0, health checks are passing, and the error rate is back to normal at 0.2%. Remaining follow-up: investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error during rollback before attempting to redeploy v2.3.1.
